svg.title: The ten TOY genes: table, distances, points and tree
svg.desc: Schematic after Compeau & Pevzner, Chapter 8, Figure 8.22, drawn from the lab's TOY data with the lab's reference code. Top left: a table of ten genes, g1 to g10, measured at three time points. Top right: the 10 by 10 matrix of Euclidean distances between them, to one decimal. Bottom left: the ten genes as points in three dimensions; they fall into three groups, g3 g5 g8, then g1 g6 g7, then g2 g4 g9 g10. Bottom right: the tree that hierarchical clustering with the average distance builds, with leaves in the order g3 g5 g8 g7 g1 g6 g10 g2 g4 g9; the height of each join is the average distance between the two clusters it joins.
svg.text: Euclidean distance between every two genes
